unsupportedReason: Unsupported on the frozen local Stack: approval.no-bypass requires the actual requester identity, an authorized same-proposal positive control and the specific separation-of-duties denial, followed by pending/unpublished readback. Stack supplies controller and optional approver credentials, not the task credential and native workspace/turn binding required by StudioDenialObserver. StudioCustodyObserver additionally requires original bootstrap retirement and isolated worker evidence. A controller self-approval attempt or generic 403 cannot substitute.

provenance.derivation: Town oracle fixtures contain no native governance, credential custody, issued-key history or clarification event identities. Null marks an unavailable expectation and must fail oracle.verify; it is never a passing baseline.
